scope: Australian ProductReview Model Y page, all years and RWD / Long Range / Performance variants. Includes original and Juniper cars, test-drive commentary and an identified expert’s borrowed-car reviews; not a verified-owner-only survey.
summary: Mostly favourable visible posts, alongside ride / control-layout and support complaints. Self-selected contributors and mixed generations make this a shopping prompt rather than reliability evidence.
positiveThemes: Owners praise smooth acceleration, storage and app / charging convenience.
Several owners report low home-energy spend and enjoyable daily driving.
negativeThemes: Some posts describe firm ride, screen-dependent controls and inconsistent driver assistance.
Individual contributors report difficulty arranging service or resolving warranty concerns.

scope: Australian ProductReview Atto 3 (2022–2026) page, mixed Standard / Extended variants and contribution dates. Visible ownership is mainly the original front-drive model; not evidence of EVO ownership.
summary: Visible reports combine satisfaction with value and everyday driving with complaints about software changes and repair support. The small, self-selected sample cannot establish fault prevalence.
positiveThemes: Owners describe comfortable family use, good value and economical home charging.
Some report satisfactory range and largely trouble-free use.
negativeThemes: Several contributors describe slow after-sales communication or repair scheduling.
Individual posts complain about a software update, reduced usable range or a steering noise.

scope: ProductReview EV6 CV RWD Air page: two contributions, one ownership report and one identified expert using a borrowed car. Original Air RWD; not a facelift-specific survey.
summary: Better variant match than the mixed EV6 parent page, but only two contributors. They praise the drive and charging while questioning equipment for the original new price.
positiveThemes: Enjoyable, quiet driving and adjustable regeneration.
negativeThemes: Equipment omissions and value against newer competitors.
Lane assistance and some cabin-material concerns.

scope: Australian ProductReview EV5 (2024–2026) page. Only one visible review, tagged GT-Line Long Range, purchased August 2026; not an Air-variant sample.
summary: The single post mainly praises the dealership purchase and delivery experience. It provides almost no long-term vehicle evidence; the five-star figure should carry very little decision weight.
positiveThemes: One buyer praises sales knowledge, finance help and delivery.
negativeThemes: No negative vehicle theme established by this one-post sample.
Long-term ownership, reliability and Air-specific evidence are missing.

scope: Australian ProductReview IONIQ 5 (2021–2026) page, mixed early RWD / AWD variants; includes two posts by the site’s identified expert using borrowed cars. Not a verified-owner-only or 84-kWh-facelift sample.
summary: Owners praise comfort and features, while individual reports describe ICCU disruption and support delays. This tiny mixed-contributor sample cannot quantify reliability or establish warranty policy.
positiveThemes: Owners describe a quiet, comfortable cabin and enjoyable driving.
Visible owners praise equipment and vehicle-to-load usefulness.
negativeThemes: One owner reports ICCU breakdowns and a lengthy repair wait.
Individual posts mention CarPlay connection trouble or concerns about connected-service privacy.

scope: No verified Australian 7X-only aggregate located. The linked ProductReview listing is a mixed Zeekr brand / dealer page covering X, 7X, purchase enquiries and delivery experiences.
summary: Model rating withheld. Visible 7X-specific posts include both purchase praise and order / communication complaints; mixing them with other models would mislabel a brand-service score as a 7X vehicle score.
positiveThemes: Some identified 7X buyers praise the car and delivery experience.
negativeThemes: Some identified 7X customers describe order delays or poor dealer communication.
Long-term 7X-specific aggregate and verified owner count remain unavailable.
